rationale: Two major functional gaps require fixing before merge. (1) validate_timezone_string does not catch ValueError raised by ZoneInfo(""), so an empty-string timezone causes an unhandled 500 instead of a 422 — affects both validation paths. (2) Three background processing paths silently drop user-supplied timezone: git/code datasource create, git/code full-reindex update, and SVN full-reindex update. The skip-reindex fast-paths for the same endpoints work correctly, creating a behavioral inconsistency where the same endpoint either stores or discards timezone depending on whether a full reindex is triggered.

business_review.notes: CronExpressionValidatorMixin gains timezone field; all 10+ inheriting request models accept the optional field.
_create_new_schedule and _update_schedule_values correctly store timezone as a CredentialValues entry when not None; no DB migration required.

APScheduler CronTrigger integration and trigger-engine threading are correct. However, three background paths (code/git datasource create and full-reindex update, SVN full-reindex update) do not forward timezone to the scheduler storage call, so the schedule is stored without the user-supplied timezone for those flows.
Scheduler response model (models/settings.py) and enrich_index_with_schedule (index_service.py) both expose timezone in API responses alongside cron_expression.
No default timezone is stored server-side; execution-time fallback is config.TIMEZONE. Clients can supply or update timezone on any update endpoint.
Backward compatibility holds for existing rows (no timezone credential → config.TIMEZONE fallback). Minor breakage: empty-string timezone input causes an unhandled 500 instead of a clean 422.

IANA validation via ZoneInfo correctly rejects UTC offset strings (UTC+2, Bad/Zone, etc.). Gap: validate_timezone_string does not catch ValueError raised by ZoneInfo(""), so empty-string input escapes validation and surfaces as a 500.

standards_review.notes: .local.env empty file is committed in this branch (appears in diff). Should be added to .gitignore or removed from the branch before merge.
No secrets, injection risks, auth bypasses, or unsafe file/process handling identified.
Commit message format not auditable from diff alone.

findings.problem: validate_timezone_string catches (ZoneInfoNotFoundError, KeyError) but not ValueError. ZoneInfo("") raises ValueError ("ZoneInfo keys must be normalized relative paths, got: "), which propagates as an unhandled 500 Internal Server Error. Applies to both the index-router Pydantic mixin path and the user-settings validator path.
findings.impact: Any client sending timezone="" receives a 500 instead of a clean 422. Stack trace is exposed. Confirmed by all three review lenses.
findings.recommendation: Extend the except clause: except (ZoneInfoNotFoundError, KeyError, ValueError). Also add "" to the invalid-timezone parametrize cases in test_scheduler_settings_service.py and test_settings_cron_validation.py.

findings.problem: Three background processing paths do not accept or forward the timezone parameter: (1) index_code_datasource_in_background (code/git datasource CREATE) has no timezone param; its caller in index.py does not forward request.timezone. (2) update_code_datasource_in_background (code/git datasource full-reindex UPDATE) same issue. (3) SVNIndexService.reindex has no timezone param; the router call at the full-reindex branch does not forward request.timezone. The skip-reindex fast-paths for these same endpoints do pass timezone correctly, creating a behavioral inconsistency.
findings.impact: Users who specify a timezone with a cron expression on git/code datasource CREATE, git/code full-reindex UPDATE, or SVN full-reindex UPDATE have their timezone silently discarded. APScheduler schedules the job in config.TIMEZONE (UTC). No error is raised; the response indicates success.
findings.recommendation: Add timezone: Optional[str] = None to index_code_datasource_in_background, update_code_datasource_in_background, and SVNIndexService.reindex. Pass request.timezone from their call sites in index.py. Add regression tests covering these paths.
